title: Workspace trust状態がAGENTS.md/MCP設定の読み込みを無言で左右し、同じRepositoryでもAgentの挙動が変わる
summary: Harnesses now gate which project-level instruction and configuration files load on a workspace trust flag. Codex stopped supplying project-level AGENTS.md instructions in untrusted projects on 2026-08-20; Claude Code v2.1.238 made a headersHelper declared in a project .mcp.json, plugin, or agent file require folder trust. The agent gives no visible signal that repo rules were withheld, so the same repository and the same prompt produce convention-violating output in a fresh or untrusted checkout - CI runners, ephemeral cloud sessions, and newly cloned worktrees being the common triggers. Operators diagnose it as 'the agent ignored our CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md' and start rewriting instructions that were never read.

evidence.title: ChatGPT & Codex changelog, 2026-08-20
evidence.summary: 'Untrusted projects no longer supply project-level AGENTS.md instructions'; 'managed deny-read rules remain enforced after permission changes'.

evidence.title: claude-code CHANGELOG v2.1.238
evidence.summary: An MCP headersHelper coming from a project .mcp.json, a plugin, or an agent file now requires folder trust; claude plugin install prompts [y/N] before running a marketplace headersHelper.

notes: Checked D08 (references circular/missing/stale), D09 (skill fails to fire when needed), C08 (env var / feature flag / runtime differences missed), C09 (repo-specific rules overridden by general rules), K04 (OS/sandbox differences change results). D09 is about matching/triggering failure; this is a trust gate that suppresses a file that would otherwise load unconditionally. C08/K04 concern the code's environment, not the harness's instruction-loading policy. Distinct enough to propose; controller may prefer to attach it to D09 as a sub-mechanism.
